{{Quote|A friend of mine, and I use the term 'friend' in this case to describe someone who loves taking my money when we're playing sabacc but otherwise ignores me, never made good on an old gambling debt.|Brennis Doore|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Temir Tonnalo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a friend, albeit a rather exploitative one, of [[Brennis Doore]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SmugglerTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Temir Tonnalo, including four female depictions deemed non-canon in Legends]]
Temir Tonnalo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
